card.name: Linking words in Rivest cryptography bios
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and', 'of', 'by' or 'about' in biographies of cryptography and search-engine founders. They sit right before a co-founder or co-inventor name or a company name, as in RSA (Rivest, Shamir, Adleman) or Google founders.

modes.label: And between co-inventors
modes.description: The word 'and' joins names of RSA co-inventors, just before the next name.
modes.example: Rivest, with Adi Shamir<< and>> Len Adleman, has been awarded

modes.label: Of or by after founder roles
modes.description: 'of' or 'by' follows a word like founder, inventor or written, before a company or founders' names.
modes.example: He is also a founder<< of>> RSA Data Security, now known as RSA

card.writes: It promotes hash and digest names like MD and SHA, which fits the cryptography setting, and suppresses unrelated nouns like ball and cup.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in biographies of the RSA cryptography inventors and the Google founders.
